title: Flowstate – Service health
description: Is the API up, fast (ADR-010 budget) and error-free? Request numbers from the request log in Loki.

panels.title: At a glance (selected range; health probes are never logged)
API alive
panels.description: A health probe was answered in the last 5 minutes (compose healthcheck on /alive, every 10 s).

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests to a real endpoint. Scanner noise (unmatched paths) is left out.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | StatusCode=~`5..` [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" [$__range]))

panels.title: p50, warm
panels.description: Median of warm requests. ADR-010 target: < 100 ms. Needs 20+ warm requests.

targets.expr: (quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" | unwrap Duration [$__range]) by (service_name) and on (service_name) (sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" [$__range])) >= 20)) or on (service_name) (sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" [$__range])) < 20) * 0 - 1

panels.title: p99, warm
panels.description: 99th percentile of warm requests. ADR-010 budget: < 500 ms. Needs 100+ warm requests; below that a p99 is just the single slowest request.

targets.expr: (quantile_over_time(0.99, {service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" | unwrap Duration [$__range]) by (service_name) and on (service_name) (sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" [$__range])) >= 100)) or on (service_name) (sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" [$__range])) < 100) * 0 - 1

panels.title: Over budget (> 500 ms)
panels.description: Warm requests slower than the p99 budget. Find them in 'Requests over budget' below.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" | Duration > 500 [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum by (status) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | label_format status=`{{ substr 0 1 .StatusCode }}xx` [$__interval]))

panels.title: Requests by caller
panels.description: session = web app or MCP client signed in via Keycloak; token = personal API token (CLI, scripts); agent = agent token. Agent parity (ADR-001) in one graph.

panels.title: 5xx by endpoint
panels.description: Server errors. Details and stack traces on the Errors & logs dashboard.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | StatusCode=~"5.." | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` [$__interval]))

panels.title: Auth failures (401 / 403) by endpoint
panels.description: Spikes after a deploy usually mean a policy change or a Keycloak problem. Expired agent tokens show up as 401s by caller 'anonymous'.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint, StatusCode) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | StatusCode=~"401|403" | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` [$__interval]))

panels.title: Scanner noise (unmatched paths)
panels.description: Requests that matched no endpoint: bots probing /wp-login.php, /.env… A rise right after a frontend deploy = the SPA calls a path that doesn't exist.

panels.title: Latency vs budget (ADR-010: p50 < 100 ms, p99 < 500 ms)
Slowest request per time bucket, and warm percentiles
panels.description: Each point is the slowest request in its bucket, split by connection. Dashed lines are the ADR-010 target and budget. A purple dot at a deploy marker is a cold start; a blue dot above the red line is a warm request over budget: find it in 'Requests over budget' below. Percentile lines only appear in buckets with enough requests; grey bars (right axis) are the request count.

targets.expr: max_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | label_format conn=`{{ if hasSuffix ":00000001" .RequestId }}new connection (cold starts land here){{ else }}reused connection (warm){{ end }}` | unwrap Duration [$__interval]) by (conn)

quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" | unwrap Duration [$__interval]) by (service_name) and on (service_name) (sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" [$__interval])) >= 20)

quantile_over_time(0.99, {service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" | unwrap Duration [$__interval]) by (service_name) and on (service_name) (sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" [$__interval])) >= 100)

panels.title: Requests over budget (> 500 ms)
panels.description: From Tempo. Click the span ID to see where the time went. Several in the same second on one instance = cold start after a deploy. 5xx = error path, not slowness. Tempo search covers at most 30 days.

targets.query: {resource.service.namespace="flowstate" && resource.service.name="api" && kind=server && duration > 500ms} | select(span.http.response.status_code, span.flowstate.caller, resource.service.instance.id, resource.service.version)

panels.title: Slow calls inside requests (over 50 ms)
panels.description: Outgoing HTTP and database calls made while serving a request: the usual causes. Keycloak .well-known/openid-configuration or certs = key discovery on a cold instance; db spans = slow SQL (look for a missing index or an N+1, ADR-010).

targets.query: {resource.service.namespace="flowstate" && resource.service.name="api" && kind=server} >> {kind=client && duration > 50ms} | select(name, span.server.address, span.url.full, span.db.system.name, span.db.system, span.db.query.text, span.db.statement)

panels.title: Endpoints (selected range)
panels.description: Grouped by route template. Median and p99 use warm requests; p99 is blank below 100 requests. A high Max with a low Median is usually one cold start. 'Over budget' = warm requests above 500 ms.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` [$__range]))

sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | StatusCode=~"4.." | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` [$__range]))

sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | StatusCode=~"5.." | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` [$__range]))

quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` | unwrap Duration [$__range]) by (endpoint)

quantile_over_time(0.99, {service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` | unwrap Duration [$__range]) by (endpoint) and on (endpoint) (sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` [$__range])) >= 100)

max_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` | unwrap Duration [$__range]) by (endpoint)

sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({service_namespace="flowstate", service_name="api"} | scope_name="Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpLogging.HttpLoggingMiddleware" | Route!="" | Route!="(unmatched)" | RequestId!~".*:00000001" | Duration > 500 | label_format endpoint=`{{ .Method }} {{ .Route }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: In-flight work
panels.description: Queued connections > 0, or DbContexts climbing without traffic = thread pool or DB trouble.

panels.title: Postgres connection pool
panels.description: Used connections near max = pool exhaustion: requests queue for a connection.
